text:
alex: Heads-up: noticed a p99 spike on /chat/complete after we flipped the kernel-selector to prefer fast-kv kernels. p50/p95 fine, p99 up ~220ms. :eyes:

marta: ugh. timeline? any correlating batch-size or kv-hit changes?

alex: Started ~1860000900 (small rollout). I pulled a quick token-level waterfall from prometheus: shows a ~180ms tail in 'kernel.compute' for some requests. Also sample traces show repeated KV misses.

kevin: can you paste the prom query? want to check batch size buckets + kernel label.

alex: sure, sample PromQL I used:
```
sum by (route,kernel,batch_size,kv_hit) (rate(token_latency_seconds_bucket[5m]))
```
Filter + histogram_quantile(0.99, ...) on token latency per-token.

marta: thanks. i see two possible hits: 1) kernel selection moved some long sequences onto a kernel with worse small-token perf, 2) KV cache eviction pattern changed -> extra memory fetches.

kevin: agree. also noticed our batching heuristic uses 90th percentile seq_len to pick kernel variant which can be brittle when distribution shifts. we should instrument "chosen_kernel" + "input_seq_len_at_dispatch" on the route KPI.

alex: proposal: add a new per-route Console card that shows token-level stacked breakdowns for p50/p95/p99 by: kernel, batch_size, kv_hit, and host. small tile for throughput + error rate. clickable dimension to pivot.

sylvie: love that. also we need alerting semantics: when p99 delta > 100ms for 5m AND error_rate > 0.5% then page route owner. can we attach owner metadata to routes?

kevin: we already have route metadata in the routing table but not surfaced to Console. we can add owner.email and runbook link. front-end change low, backend needs to join metadata with metric queries.

infra-bot: perf-profiler job completed for route=/chat/complete at 1860001002. artifacts: s3://redwood-perf/profiles/1860001002/chat-complete.tgz :robot_face:

alex: I downloaded the profile: CPU hotspots show kernel memcpy + kv-fetch stalls correlated with specific model shard. pushing traces to perf viz.

marta: actionable next steps: 1) add kernel & kv_hit labels to per-route metric emissions (runtime), 2) new Console card prototype (kevin + frontend), 3) route owner metadata join (platform), 4) create an alert rule in signalboard with the conditions sylvie suggested.

kevin: I'll sketch the dashboard layout today. rough sketch: top row: p50/p95/p99 token-latency stacked bars (kernel colors), throughput sparkline, error rate percent. second row: heatmap of batch_size vs kv_hit with counts, dropdown to filter kernel. drill to raw traces.

alex: for instrumentation, runtime change diff (pseudo):
```
metrics.emit("token_latency", labels={"route": route, "kernel": chosen_kernel, "kv_hit": kv_hit?"yes":"no", "batch_size": batch})
```
Also add "input_seq_len_at_dispatch" gauge.

ops-bot: noticed autoscaler scaled up pool-gamma at 1860001045 due to sustained queue depth. might be related.

marta: good catch. queue depth + scale events correlate with the p99 tail. might be transient during rollout. still worth having the card and alerting in case it regresses.

kevin: timeline/owners: i can have a prototype dashboard (+ mock data) by EOD tomorrow. platform team (sylvie) to add owner metadata and join by EOD+2. runtime (alex) to add labels and a canary rollout for metric emission.

sylvie: will add owner/email/runbook to route registry and expose via /api/internal/routes by tomorrow. also will add a simple playbook entry for kernel rollouts.

alex: i'll open a short PR for the metric labels and enable under a feature flag. will include sampling guard to avoid cardinality blowup.

marta: thanks everyone. once dashboards exist we'll validate with the profiler artifacts and run a controlled rollback if tail persists. :hammer_and_wrench:
